facts.claim: Kempe Cauda ruled his territory with benevolence and justice for seventy years from 1443 to 1513.
facts.quote: This chief governed his territory with benevolence and justice for the long space of 70 years (1443-1513).

facts.claim: Kempe Cauda built a mud fort and named the new town Bengaluru in the year 1537.
facts.quote: in 1537 built a mud fort and transferred to his new town the name of Bengaluru (Bangalore).
